mla.name: Dr. Pramod Sawant
mla.portfolio: Chief Minister of Goa (Home, Finance, Personnel & Education)
mla.about: Serving as the 13th Chief Minister of Goa since 2019. Represented Sanquelim constituency across three consecutive terms (2012, 2017, 2022). An ayurvedic medical practitioner by training, he has led statewide infrastructure, health modernization, and economic diversification programs.

mp.name: Shripad Yesso Naik
mp.portfolio: Union Minister of State for Power & New and Renewable Energy
mp.about: Elected to the Lok Sabha for six consecutive terms from North Goa since 1999. Serves as Union Minister of State for Power and New & Renewable Energy. Previously held independent charge of the Ministry of AYUSH and served as Union Minister of State for Defence.

key_movements.title: 2024 Lok Sabha Consolidation
key_movements.desc: Massive 80.0% sweep across all 50 booths in parliamentary voting.

key_movements.title: 2022 Assembly Razor-Thin Gap
key_movements.desc: INC narrowed the margin to just 666 votes (2.6%) in 2022 state elections.

key_movements.title: 2012 Landmark Breakthrough
key_movements.desc: Pramod Sawant flipped Sanquelim from INC with a decisive 66.1% majority.

takeaways: Sanquelim displays strong split-ticket voting behavior: parliamentary contests yield 65%–80% BJP surges, whereas assembly elections are vigorously contested (2.6% margin in 2022).
Cotombi, Surla, and Navelim represent solid fortress villages with >35% BJP margins consistently across all cycles.
RGP captured 4.0% vote share in 2024 Lok Sabha, indicating emerging alternative regional presence.
